Actual hosting, consensus/recovery, cold restore, forks, quorum policy, independent operators and release remain separate gates.

Read-only checks verify the fixture mint/escrow and bracket them with selected token-programme code and authority pins. Complete funded genesis backing, native reserve reconciliation, remaining metadata unknown-landing/expiry recovery and competing-fork testing, independent operators and custody, compatible upgrade/rollback and fork tests and external security review remain required before live redemption. A controlled lost-connection rehearsal preserves one handed-out withdrawal through actual expiry without a second handoff or refund.
